description: Verify that the Type field of the IPv4 Endpoint Option is 0x04 (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Endpoint Option: Type == 0x04.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's Type field == 0x04.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Type on the wire equals 0x04.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_type — Non-IPv4-endpoint option present in offer
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
